native_run_binding.force_metrics: The analyzed receipt-bound observations do not contain free_force_imbalance_l2_N or free_force_imbalance_max_N; screens use phase endpoint plastic strain and reaction moment only.
native_run_binding.mixed_certificate: The 1e-4 certificate residual is an environment-wide generalized norm over FEM/field/MPM/rigid/support blocks, divided by max(last Newton FGMRES initial norm, 1). The vector mixes units; when the denominator is 1 it behaves as an absolute algebraic residual threshold, not a directly interpretable force tolerance.
native_run_binding.residual_buffer_review: The getter exposes final reassembled generalized residual rows after accepted preDynamics. FEM xyz are impulses (N s), including inertia and contact; mixed pressure is w. Constrained rows can receive contact assembly entries, so the probe filters using the accepted node constraint tag before dividing free xyz rows by the actual one-substep dt. This yields free-node force-balance residuals in N, not the normalized mixed certificate.
native_run_binding.run_inputs: Canonical archived native runs and compressed inputs are in ../runs/.
native_run_binding.source_version: Those resolution receipts predate femMechanicalResidualBuffer and free-force CSV columns. Current source for the residual contract review is separately referenced in source-snapshots/SHA256SUMS.json and is not retroactively bound to those runs.
